title: 跟……一样 in Chinese: How to Say "the Same as" (HSK 3)
description: How to use 跟……一样 (gēn... yíyàng) for "the same as" and "as... as" in Chinese: word order, 不一样, 没有 for "not as", common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: How to Say "the Same as" with 跟……一样
lede: 一样 (yíyàng) means "the same". With 跟 (gēn) or 和 (hé) in front of the second thing, A 跟 B 一样 says that A and B are the same. Add an adjective after it to say "as tall as", "as hot as" and so on.

sections.h2: A 跟 B 一样: "the same as"
paras: 跟 and 和 both work here and mean the same. To ask if two things are the same, add 吗 at the end. Before a noun, use 一样的: 一样的书包 is "the same school bag". With a verb, 跟……一样 means "like": 我跟你一样，也喜欢喝茶 is "Like you, I like tea too".

examples.py: Wǒ de shǒujī gēn nǐ de yíyàng.
examples.en: My phone is the same as yours.

examples.py: Nǐ de shū gēn wǒ de yíyàng ma?
examples.en: Is your book the same as mine?

examples.zh: 我和妹妹有一样的书包。
examples.py: Wǒ hé mèimei yǒu yíyàng de shūbāo.
examples.en: My little sister and I have the same school bag.

examples.zh: 我跟你一样，也喜欢喝茶。
examples.py: Wǒ gēn nǐ yíyàng, yě xǐhuan hē chá.
examples.en: Like you, I like tea too.

sections.h2: A 跟 B 一样 + adjective: "as... as"
paras: A + 跟 + B + 一样 + adjective.

The adjective goes after 一样, never before it. The most common mistake is to follow English word order and say 他跟我高一样; the right order is 他跟我一样高. To talk about how well someone does something, use a verb with 得 first.

examples.py: Tā gēn tā bàba yíyàng gāo.
examples.en: He's as tall as his dad.
Today is just as hot as yesterday.

examples.zh: 这件衣服和那件一样贵。
examples.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu hé nà jiàn yíyàng guì.
examples.en: This top costs the same as that one.

examples.zh: 他说汉语说得跟中国人一样好。
examples.py: Tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de gēn Zhōngguórén yíyàng hǎo.
examples.en: He speaks Chinese as well as a Chinese person.

sections.h2: Negatives: 不一样 and 没有
paras: To say two things are different, put 不 directly before 一样: A 跟 B 不一样. A common mistake is to put 不 before 跟 instead. Note the pinyin: 不一样 is bù yíyàng.
To say "not as tall as" or "not as expensive as", Chinese usually uses 没有 instead: A + 没有 + B + adjective.

examples.py: Zhè liǎng ge zì bù yíyàng.

examples.zh: 中国人的名字跟我们的不一样。
examples.py: Zhōngguórén de míngzi gēn wǒmen de bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Chinese names are different from ours.
The younger brother isn't as tall as the older one.

worksheet.title: 跟……一样 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 跟……一样 worksheet for HSK 3: 18 exercises (一样, 不一样 or 比, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 一样, 不一样 or 比
exercises.instructions: Write 一样, 不一样 or 比 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: My school bag is the same as yours.
He's two years older than me.
These two tops are different colours.

items.zh: 这个房间跟那个房间＿＿大。
items.en: This room is as big as that one.
Food in the south is different from food in the north.
The underground is cheaper than a taxi.
Like you, I'm a student too.
What you said is different from what he said.
My little sister is taller than me.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: This place is different now from how it used to be.
answers: 这儿现在跟以前不一样。
现在这儿跟以前不一样。

items.en: He runs as fast as me.
Are these two characters the same?
My younger sister isn't as tall as my older sister.
This dish is just as tasty as that one.
answers: 这个菜和那个菜一样好吃。
那个菜和这个菜一样好吃。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 这本书跟那本书贵一样。
items.en: This book costs the same as that one.
answers: 这本书跟那本书一样贵。
这本书和那本书一样贵。

items.zh: 这件衣服的颜色不跟那件一样。
items.en: This top is a different colour from that one.
answers: 这件衣服的颜色跟那件不一样。
这件衣服的颜色和那件不一样。

items.zh: 他汉语说得跟中国人一样很好。
items.en: He speaks Chinese as well as a Chinese person.
answers: 他汉语说得跟中国人一样好。
他汉语说得和中国人一样好。
